limitations: Live schema, definition, localization and relation facets cover the pinned full legacy schema and preserve explicit installed-schema extensions; they are not a portable UVD artifact.

Full planning requires enough caller budget for the official sc2data.xml bootstrap and 108 namespace catalog files per dependency; smaller callers retain the bootstrap plus eight Product-GA priority catalogs with an explicit coverage warning. Built-in ##id##/$id substitution is resolved and unresolved declared token templates are excluded from concrete graph edges; full declared/global token substitution, schema validator execution and localized sources other than GameStrings remain named remainder.

The optional edit-target service resolves only the active writable mod context, returns every document revision guard and computes a re-resolved prospective value. It returns logical replacement/create output; permissions, binding selection, commit, history and atomicity remain host responsibilities.
